title: A SHARED schema that REFUSES. No contract sits beside it, exactly like common/pagination.
$comment: `xyzzy` is in neither the shape list nor the constraint list, so this node must be refused. That refusal is the INPUT to the cascade test: a module that imports it must not be written. If a future keyword list ever admits `xyzzy`, this fixture stops testing anything and the cascade cases go green for the wrong reason — pick another name that is in neither list rather than deleting the case.
